claim_text: The Houston church gunman detail repeated with more than a hundred rounds of ammunition and the tackle by church security during a Sunday service, which he says is exactly what they had been praying over and believes their prayers stopped.
quote: This is what we were praying for
falsify_match: The earlier word naming Houston and a church attack before the arrest.
falsify_miss: Pray over Houston is on the record in this corpus; whether the sympathiser and the church were attached to it is the question, and the man was stopped by security rather than by nothing happening.
